endpoints.label: MAVLink
endpoints.hint: QGroundControl: Application Settings → Comm Links → Add → Type UDP → Server: this host and port. Mission Planner: pick UDPCl and enter it.
endpoints.appHint: Aircast QGroundControl sets itself up from the button below — cameras and telemetry in one tap.

schemes.label: UDP · Wait for a ground station
schemes.hint: Any ground station on the network connects to this device on this port. The usual choice.

schemes.label: UDP · Send to a ground station
schemes.hint: The device sends telemetry to this address. Use it when the ground station cannot reach the device first.

schemes.label: UDP · Broadcast to the network
schemes.hint: Every ground station on the local network gets telemetry on this port.

schemes.label: TCP · Wait for a ground station
schemes.hint: A ground station opens a TCP connection to this device on this port. Slower to recover on a lossy link than UDP.

schemes.label: TCP · Connect to a server
schemes.hint: The device opens a TCP connection to this server and sends telemetry over it.
